existing_group_assignments.rationale: Generic 'Hyperplasia' is the same process as the tissue-specific hyperplasia events in this group, lacking a context qualifier.
Promotion of hepatocellular carcinoma is the same liver tumor endpoint as the events in this group; flagged here due to the 'promotion' wording.
'decreased, Fertility' is the same event as 'Decrease, Fertility'.
Increase in cell injury/death is a general cell-death event that fits this apoptosis/cell death context group.
Acetylcholine accumulation in synapses is a cholinergic event related to the AChE-inhibition-linked group; flagged for curator review.
Reduced reproductive success is the same endpoint as 'Decreased, Reproductive Success', in the opposite direction to 'Increased'.
Decreased LH surge is the same event as 'Decreased, LH Surge from anterior pituitary'.
Decreased GnRH pulsatility/release is the same as 'Decreased, GnRH pulsatility/release in hypothalamus'.
Reduced prostaglandins in ovary is a related reduced-prostaglandin event in a differing biological context/specificity.
Decreased fecundity is the same event as 'Decrease, Fecundity' and the F3-specific variant, differing only in generation context.
placeholder
Increased endometrial adenocarcinomas is the same carcinoma-increase process in another tissue (endometrium).
Increased Leydig cell tumors is the same tumor-increase process in another tissue context.
Necrosis in terminal bronchiolar cells is a cell-type-specific cytotoxic cell injury event like the other cytotoxicity contexts.
HMG-CoA reductase inhibition shares the same mevalonate/cholesterol synthesis pathway object but is a distinct process.
'Increase, Mutations in Critical Genes' is a wording variant of 'Increased, Induced Mutations in Critical Genes' and describes increased mutations.

Decreased T3 is the same endpoint as the existing T3 tissue-level events and is in the opposite direction to 'Increased, T3 in tissues'; the existing group is a soda pair, so this fits the same endpoint family.
Decreased plasma PGF2alpha concentration is the same event as the plasma member of this group, differing only in wording.
Increased PPAR-alpha activation is the directional opposite of the decreased PPAR-alpha activation member for the same receptor.
"Lipid Peroxidation" is the same event as "Increase, Lipid peroxidation" in the existing group, with different wording.
"Decrease, Cell proliferation" is a general form of decreased proliferation/growth, differing in biological context from cortical neural progenitor cell proliferation.
Decrease, Triglyceride shares the triglyceride object with the existing increased-triglyceride events but differs in direction/process, warranting curator review.
Reduced granulosa cell proliferation placeholder not valid; omitted.
Increased retinoic acid receptor activation shares the retinoic acid receptor object with the existing decreased RAR activation event and is flagged for curator review.
Increased atRA concentration shares the atRA object with the decreased atRA concentration event, flagged for curator review.
Extracellular matrix deposition is a more general form of collagen deposition, flagged for curator review.
General increased cell proliferation matches the existing group of increased cell proliferation in various contexts.
Decreased serum thyroid hormone (T4/T3) is the same decrease in a serum context, parallel to T4 decreases in serum and neuronal tissue.
Decreased brain thyroid hormone is the same decrease in a different tissue context from T4 in serum or neuronal tissue.
Activation of mTORC1 is a distinct pathway component of the PI3K/AKT/mTOR activation group, flagged for curator review.
Increase, Necrosis is a form of increased cell death, matching the cell death/apoptosis group of varying specificity.
Increase, TNF is a specific increased pro-inflammatory mediator and fits the increased mediators group.
Activation of caspases is related to caspase transcription but is a distinct process on the same object, flagged for curator review.
Insulin resistance is the same glucose-uptake/insulin signalling theme as GLUT4/glucose uptake decrease but a distinct process, flagged for curator review.
Non-alcoholic fatty liver disease is a hepatic steatosis-related pathology; this is a broader disease-level event rather than a synonym, but closest existing group.
Increase, Pro-Inflammatory Mediators is the same event as the existing increased pro-inflammatory mediators members, differing only in wording.
placeholder
Increased pro-inflammatory cytokine expression describes the same increased pro-inflammatory mediator state under different wording.
Increased vascular endothelial dysfunction is the same event as endothelial cell dysfunction.
Mitochondrial Complex I inhibition is the same event as 'Inhibition, NADH-ubiquinone oxidoreductase (complex I)', and the group tracks Complex I binding vs inhibition.
Increased lipid degradation is closest to increased fatty acid beta-oxidation but is a broader process, so it is flagged as a different-context variant rather than a merge.

new_groups.rationale: Both describe decreased circulating neuropeptide hormones (ETH, CCAP) in the ecdysis cascade.
Ecdysone receptor hyperactivation and E75b nuclear receptor gene expression share the ecdysone signaling axis but are distinct processes.
Decreased ketogenesis and not-increased circulating ketone bodies concern ketone bodies but are production versus level.
Glucuronyltransferase upregulation and increased T4 clearance are linked thyroid hormone metabolism events but distinct processes.
All describe altered hippocampal features (gene expression, anatomy, physiology) at different levels.
Binding at the picrotoxin site and reduced chloride channel conductance concern the same iGABAR channel but binding does not confirm functional reduction.
NF-kB inhibition and induction of IkB inhibitory protein share the NF-kB axis but are different processes.
Suppression of the immune system generally versus suppression of inflammatory cytokines and decreased lymphocytes are the same theme at different specificity.
All are KER-style upstream events for decreased testosterone by fetal Leydig cells, differing in the upstream trigger/context.
All describe decreased testosterone production by adult Leydig cells via different upstream contexts.
Different cholesterol-supply processes under the 'Decreased cholesterol' theme, flagged for curator review.
Both describe increased apoptosis of Leydig cells, with differing specificity (fetal/adult vs adult).
Both describe reduced steroidogenic enzyme/protein expression with differing wording and specificity.
Adipogenic transcription factor activation (PPAR-gamma, C/EBPalpha) and increased adipogenesis are related but distinct processes.
Decreased dopamine and decreased reward are related but distinct events needing curator review.
LXR alpha activation and SREBP1c inhibition are related lipogenic regulators, different molecules; flagged for curator review.
Down-regulation of CPT1A, HMGCS2 and decreased ketogenesis are related decreased fatty acid oxidation/ketogenic events at differing specificity.
Accumulation of damaged mitochondrial DNA and overwhelmed mtDNA repair concern the same mtDNA damage theme; flagged for curator review.
Reduced spawning behavior, mate attraction and pheromone release are related reduced reproductive behavior events; flagged for curator review.
Both concern norepinephrine receptor signaling on GnRH neurons, as decreased NE binding versus NE receptor antagonism, which are distinct processes.
Tubulin binding, microtubule dynamics disruption, and meiotic spindle disorganization share the tubulin/microtubule object but are distinct processes.
Several decreased renal functional measures (GFR, plasma flow, sodium reabsorption, urine dilution) concern the kidney but are distinct processes; flagged for curator review.
GTPCH-1, tetrahydrobiopterin and nitric oxide are different molecules in the same eNOS/NO pathway, grouped only for curator review of the shared pathway (not as synonyms).
Placental insufficiency and preeclampsia are related pregnancy outcome events at different specificity, flagged for curator review.
Both concern thyroxine (T4) increases but one is free serum concentration and the other is uptake into tissue, which are distinct processes.
Increased inhibitory postsynaptic potential and increased neuronal synaptic inhibition both concern synaptic inhibition, at different specificity, flagged for curator review.
Both belong to the calcineurin-NFAT immunosuppression axis but are distinct processes (cytokine production suppression vs enzyme activity inhibition); flagged for curator review.
Both concern smooth muscle but describe proliferation/clonal expansion versus hypertrophy/hyperplasia, which are related but distinct processes.
Hyperplasia in different ovarian cell types (stromal cells vs epithelium).
Decreased bile flow and increased cholestasis share the bile object but are distinct events needing curator review.
Decreased photosynthesis and decreased light harvest capacity are related plant photosynthetic function decreases at different specificity.
Reduction of different androgens/precursors (DHEA, androstenedione, DHT) in the same androgen biosynthesis pathway, flagged for curator review.
Tyrosinase inhibition and reduced L-dopaquinone (its product) concern the same enzymatic step but are distinct processes.
Binding of stabilizing agents to microtubules is distinct from the resulting disturbance of microtubule dynamic instability.

Sperm count, impaired spermatogenesis and decreased spermatogenesis concern the male germ cell production axis with distinct endpoints; 1758 and 1798 are near-synonyms but sperm count is a distinct measure.
Both describe decreased cortisol, one also including 11β-(OH) testosterone.
Inhibition of different chitin-degrading enzymes (chitinase vs chitobiase) share the chitin degradation context but are distinct enzymes.
Urothelial cell injury/death and urothelial tumor share the urothelial tissue object but are distinct processes.
Increased differentiation to testis and male-biased sex ratio are related sex determination endpoints at different levels.
Abnormal osmoregulation and body fluid overload are related but distinct processes.
Both concern neutrophil/platelet thromboinflammatory interactions but describe distinct processes (NET formation vs platelet-neutrophil interaction).
Impaired gustatory nerve, dysgeusia and imbalanced taste responses are taste-function impairments at differing specificity.
Sustentacular cell decrease, olfactory sensory neuron decrease and epithelium degeneration all concern the olfactory epithelium but distinct cell-level and tissue-level processes.
D1 protein deactivation, oxygen-evolving complex damage and decreased PSII efficiency all concern photosystem II but are distinct processes.
Abnormal neuroblast migration and periventricular heterotopia formation are related neurodevelopmental events at different levels of biological organisation.
Hyperactivation of the ACE/Ang-II/AT1R axis and sodium-sensitive hypertension are related pathway and outcome events flagged for curator review.
Both describe altered expression of otic development genes (six1b increased, eya1 inhibited) in the same developmental pathway; flagged for curator review.
Prolongation of action potential duration (cellular) and QT interval prolongation (organ-level ECG) are the same process at different biological scales.
Increased activation of platelets versus neutrophils: the same process in different cell types.
Decline of neural progenitor cells and premature differentiation are related neural progenitor events; flagged for curator review of specificity.
Increased tumor growth (general) and metastatic breast cancer (tissue-specific) describe related tumor progression at different specificity.
Both describe inflammation, one general pathway activation and one specific to the lung.
Both concern folate handling (transporter affected vs decreased uptake), related but distinct processes of the same object.
Defects in tanning of new cuticle and impaired cuticle sclerotization describe the same cuticle hardening/tanning impairment.
Metabotropic glutamate receptor activation and IP3 receptor activation are linked signalling steps but distinct receptors; flagged for curator review.
Both concern bone tissue but bone remodeling and bone loss are distinct processes.
Bcl-2 and Bax are different proteins in the same apoptosis regulatory axis, flagged for curator review.
These all concern oligodendrocyte maturation/differentiation and myelination but describe distinct processes of the same cell lineage.
Radial glia and neural progenitor laminin adhesion events concern related neural progenitor/radial glia biology but are distinct processes.
Loss of drebrin and abnormal dendritic spine morphology involve the same dendritic spine structure but are distinct processes.
Decreased expression of different neural/glial marker genes (elavl3, sox10, mbp) are the same process type on different gene objects, flagged for review.
Pulmonary epithelial injury and airway inflammation are related respiratory tissue-level events at different specificity.
These events concern chitin organization and protection in the insect cuticle but are distinct processes.
Both concern adipocytes but increased size (hypertrophy) and increased number (hyperplasia) are distinct processes.
Both are prostate neoplastic events at different stages/specificity (intraepithelial neoplasia vs cancer).
Influenza A virus receptor binding and cell entry are distinct processes involving the same virus-receptor interaction.
Virus production, budding, and shedding/transmission are distinct processes of the influenza virus lifecycle.
Angiogenesis dysfunction and vascular disrupting effects are overlapping vascular outcomes at differing specificity; flagged for curator review.
Activation of gluten-reactive CD4+ T cells vs B cells are the same process in different cell types.
Generation of gluten-reactive T cell receptors vs B cell receptors are the same process in different cell types.
Both concern increased lysolecithin, one general and one specifically as membrane integration; flagged for curator review of specificity.
Both describe increased estrogen status in plasma, one as estradiol concentration and one as estradiol-to-progesterone ratio.
Both concern the INSIG1-SREBP2 regulatory axis but describe different molecules and processes; flagged for curator review.
Both concern sodium homeostasis in fish but gill uptake and plasma concentration are distinct processes/compartments.
Both concern FAM50B/PTCHD3 but describe expression increase versus DNA methylation decrease, distinct processes of the same gene targets.
Both concern photosystem II, but inhibition of the complex and decreased electron transport through it are distinct processes needing curator review.
